about: Worker C's picture cost at one held pose (Nov 16): one con_custodial launch, rtx keys changed live at y0_p0, about 10 s per step, then final and game depth dumped at the end of each step (live_stepN_final.pfm, live_stepN_gamedepth.pfm). Steps: 1 base, 2 RR CNN, 3 RR transformer with DLSS balanced, 4 DLSS performance, 5 DLSS quality (base again; step 5 against step 1 is the noise floor). A step counts only with its new '[RTX Ray Reconstruction] created: render WxH' line or RR preset change in remix-dxvk.log. Score with tests\analysis\picture_cost.py.
